title: mris_make_surfaces
description: Positions the tessellation of the cortical surface at the white matter surface, then the gray matter surface, generating surface files along with a curvature file and a surface file for cortical thickness.

white.description: Output name for white surface (default is 'white'). Set to NOWHITE to generate but not save white surface.
white.title: White Surface Name

pial.description: Output name for pial surface (default is 'pial').
pial.title: Pial Surface Name

orig_white.description: Specify a white surface to start with.
orig_white.title: Original White Surface

orig_pial.description: Specify a pial surface to start with.
orig_pial.title: Original Pial Surface

q.description: Omit self-intersection and only generate gray/white surface.
q.title: Q Flag

c.description: Do not create curvature and area files from white matter surface.
c.title: C Flag

cortex.description: Set to 0 to turn off creation of cortex label file.
cortex.title: Cortex Flag

first_wm_peak.description: Settle WM surface at first peak in intensity profile instead of highest.
first_wm_peak.title: First WM Peak Flag

a_avgs.description: Average curvature values a number of times (default=10).
a_avgs.title: Average Curvature

pa_avgs.description: Average pial curvature values a max of a number of times (default=16).
pa_avgs.title: Average Pial Curvature

wa_avgs.description: Average white curvature values a max of a number of times (default=4).
wa_avgs.title: Average White Curvature

dura_thresh.description: Set a threshold for the multi-echo mprage dura avoidance.
dura_thresh.title: Dura Threshold

erase_cerebellum.description: Erase cerebellar labeled voxels if aseg is loaded.
erase_cerebellum.title: Erase Cerebellum Flag

wm_weight.description: Weighting of WM mean in calculating T2 threshold of disallowed GM values, default=3.
wm_weight.title: WM Weight

nsigma_above.description: # of sigmas above the mean to allow gray matter T2 intensities.
nsigma_above.title: Sigma Above

nsigma_below.description: # of sigmas below the mean to allow gray matter T2 intensities.
nsigma_below.title: Sigma Below

t2_min_inside.description: Specify threshold for min T2 value allowed to be interior to the cortical ribbon.
t2_min_inside.title: Min T2 Inside

t2_max_inside.description: Specify threshold for max T2 value allowed to be interior to the cortical ribbon.
t2_max_inside.title: Max T2 Inside

t2_outside_min.description: Specify threshold for min T2 value outside of pial surface that will cause surface to deform outwards.
t2_outside_min.title: Min T2 Outside

t2_outside_max.description: Specify threshold for max T2 value outside of pial surface that will cause surface to deform outwards.
t2_outside_max.title: Max T2 Outside

min_peak_pct.description: Specify the pct of the histo peak in the local gm histogram to use as threshold for finding the local inside and outside gm thresholds.
min_peak_pct.title: Min Peak %

border_vals_hires.description: Turn on hires options in MRIScomputeBorderValues_new(). May not be helpful.
border_vals_hires.title: Border Vals Hires

tspring.description: Set weight of tangential spring cost.
tspring.title: Tangential Spring Cost

nspring.description: Set weight of normal spring cost.
nspring.title: Normal Spring Cost

diag_vertex.description: Set Gdiag_no to vertex number and turn off writing of cortex label or curvature files.
diag_vertex.title: Diagnostic Vertex

rip.description: Save ripflag as overlay. Specify full path including hemi, suffix, etc.
rip.title: Rip File

sigma_white.description: Save white surface sigma as overlay. Specify full path including hemi, suffix, etc.
sigma_white.title: Sigma White File

sigma_pial.description: Save pial surface sigma as overlay. Specify full path including hemi, suffix, etc.
sigma_pial.title: Sigma Pial File

output.description: Append suffix to all outputs to prevent over-writing.
output.title: Output Suffix
